title: Fix typo in installation docs
body:
In docs/install.md the command `pip instal requests` is missing a 'l'.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open docs/install.md
2. Copy the command from the Quick start section

Expected: `pip install requests`.
This is a one-line change and a good way to make a first contribution.

comments.author: maintainer-jane
comments.body: Thanks for spotting this! PRs welcome.

title: Add unit tests for the date parser
body:
The function parse_date in src/utils/dates.py has no tests.

Please add tests in tests/test_dates.py covering ISO dates, empty strings and invalid input.

title: Improve error message when config file is missing
body: When config.yaml is missing the app crashes with a stack trace. It should print a friendly message instead. See src/config.py, function load_config.
